propositions: A passing plan review must sign and persist a claim-valid attestation by default on every mutating public plan-review entry point (CLI and library), unless an explicit opt-out is provided.
Explicit unsigned execution requires --no-sign flag at CLI boundary and sign=False parameter at library boundary, with clear output indicating whether signing was performed.
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and local-source verdicts must never sign; explicit sign=False must withhold signatures; guards must be pinned in the attest.sign_plan_review seam.
Re-running the operation with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it idempotently without triggering a second LLM call or duplicate signature event.
A PASS with signature-persistence failure must return the established retryable nonzero disposition and identify sign-review as the recovery path.
All user-facing documentation and CLI help must accurately reflect the sign-by-default contract, explicit opt-out syntax, never-sign conditions, and recovery behavior.
